name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 👂 Helping Wingman hear you (Settings): it learns words you put right by voice ("change vinyl to thymol"), kept on your phone. Sharing the words, and keeping recordings of what it missed, only if you say so.
👂 Each question tells the phone what answers to expect (none, light, medium or heavy for the smoke), so short answers are heard right through noise.
🌬️ When the phone's listening freezes in loud noise, Wingman asks you to say it again right away instead of going quiet.
💊 "…Mite Away Quick Strips, two strips": a pause before the amount no longer loses it. Splits wait for the rest of your plan too.
👂 Many more misheard words understood in bee-yard noise (HopGuard, ApiLife Var, Api-Bioxal, Tylan, "a puff or two of smoke", Yellow-Legged Hornets).
